# Daily X Report — 2026-11-10

Two threads ran in parallel today. On AI: Claude Fable 5.2 / Mythos 5.2 launched and OpenAI shipped Control Room, upgrading both model capability and control tooling on the same day. On markets: Anthropic announced its IPO roadshow targeting a Dec 10 NYSE listing, while the Nvidia saga kept escalating; meanwhile the SOX index fell deep into oversold territory and SoftBank posted its first net loss in nearly two years — more signs the AI trade is cooling. Tomorrow's October CPI will be released without year-over-year figures, as the data is missing.

## AI / Agents

### 1. Claude Fable 5.2 and Claude Mythos 5.2 are live
Anthropic launched Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2, built for the most demanding technical collaboration, with gains in coding, reasoning, and vision — the day's biggest model release, with 11M views.
https://x.com/claudeai/status/2119867114450268322

### 2. Fable 5.2 designed three working electronic devices from a single prompt
In pre-release testing, Fable 5.2 designed three working electronic devices — including a home voice-assistant hub — from one prompt, writing specs, picking components, wiring, and programming them itself: end-to-end hardware design by an agent.
https://x.com/claudeai/status/2119899459761131615

### 3. OpenAI launches Control Room to track and quickly stop model workloads
OpenAI launched Control Room to centrally track all model workloads across its research infrastructure and stop them fast on safety or security issues, covering agent sampling, training evals, and data processing — able to halt or pause a task's model output within 35 seconds of deciding to intervene.
https://x.com/OpenAI/status/2119913172039868579

## AI video & world models

### 4. Runway launches Sightline: frame any shot from a 360° panorama
Runway's new Sightline creates a 360° panorama of any location and lets you frame any shot from any angle, keeping the environment consistent across shots; panoramas export as 3D environments for scene work in App Studio.
https://x.com/runwayml/status/2119874555581694370

## Finance & markets

### 5. Anthropic launches IPO roadshow, targeting Dec 10 NYSE listing
Anthropic announced it launched its IPO roadshow, targeting a Dec 10 NYSE listing under ticker $ANTC — a landmark step for a frontier AI lab going public.
https://x.com/AnthropicAI/status/2120117722230968385

### 6. Nvidia saga escalates: class-action suit and $7.5B chip-shipment allegation
Nvidia and Jensen Huang face a class-action suit alleging shareholder fraud over concealing Huang's relationship with a woman identified by US intelligence as a Chinese intelligence operative; separately, The Information reports that relationship facilitated at least $7.5B in Nvidia chip shipments, dating back to 2023. As reported in the posts; not independently verified.
https://x.com/KobeissiLetter/status/2119937712102760784
https://x.com/KobeissiLetter/status/2120110889693245744

### 7. October CPI will have no year-over-year figure, missing data from the 2025 shutdown
The BLS said this week's October CPI will carry no year-over-year number, because the October 2025 government shutdown left data missing, making a reliable annual comparison impossible; only monthly data will be provided — tomorrow's market focal point.
https://x.com/KobeissiLetter/status/2119960893228286123

### 8. Magnificent Seven's off-balance-sheet obligations total $4.49T, ~6x on-balance-sheet
Alphabet, Meta, Anthropic, Microsoft, Amazon, Oracle, and Nvidia disclose combined off-balance-sheet obligations of $4.49T (Alphabet $1.08T, Anthropic $865B, Meta $810B on top) — future lease payments, data-center commitments, and equipment purchases not yet begun — versus just $758B on-balance-sheet; total obligations about $5.25T.
https://x.com/KobeissiLetter/status/2119879354045915540

### 9. SOX semiconductor index 17% below its 200-day average, widest gap since April 2025
The SOX semiconductor index fell 17% below its 200-day moving average — the largest negative deviation since April 2025 and the second-largest since the 2022 bear market — as semis swung from extremely overbought to oversold within months.
https://x.com/KobeissiLetter/status/2119977845267087519

### 10. SoftBank posts first net loss in nearly two years as AI-spending fears hit tech holdings
SoftBank reported its first net loss in nearly two years, as worries over AI spending and demand weighed on its main tech holdings — a signature earnings signal of the AI trade cooling.
https://x.com/business/status/2120043789897134231

### 11. US oil falls below $85
After Trump said no further strikes on Iran are needed, US oil fell below $85/bbl for the first time since Aug 31, down 19% from its Oct 30 high.
https://x.com/KobeissiLetter/status/2120083569808699696

### 12. US equity fund demand unprecedented: $2.1T inflows since 2020
US equity funds have drawn a record $2.1T since 2020 — $1.5T of it since 2024, 4.5x the inflows into emerging-market Asia funds over the same period — a solid data point for watching fund flows.
https://x.com/KobeissiLetter/status/2120010057450418347

# 今日推特精选报告（2026-11-10）

今日主线是两条并行的线：AI 一侧，Claude Fable 5.2 / Mythos 5.2 正式上线、OpenAI 推出 Control Room，模型能力与管控工具同日升级；金融一侧，Anthropic 宣布启动 IPO 路演、计划 12 月 10 日纽交所上市，而英伟达风波继续发酵，同时半导体指数跌入超卖、软银出现近两年来首次净亏损，AI 交易降温信号增多。明日 10 月 CPI 将发布，但因数据缺失不含同比数字。

## 一、AI 实用 / Agent

### 1. Claude Fable 5.2 与 Claude Mythos 5.2 正式上线
Anthropic 推出新一代模型 Fable 5.2 与 Mythos 5.2，称其能胜任各领域最具挑战性的技术协作，在编码、推理和视觉方面均有提升；本日 AI 方向最重要的模型发布，11M 浏览。
原帖：https://x.com/claudeai/status/2119867114450268322

### 2. Fable 5.2 凭一段提示设计出三台可工作的电子设备
发布前测试中，Fable 5.2 仅凭一段提示就设计出三台可工作的电子设备，包括家庭语音助手主机，自行写规格、选元器件、布线并编程，展示了智能体端到端的硬件设计能力。
原帖：https://x.com/claudeai/status/2119899459761131615

### 3. OpenAI 推出 Control Room：集中追踪并快速停止模型工作负载
OpenAI 推出 Control Room，可集中追踪研究基础设施内所有模型工作负载，并在出现安全或安保问题时快速停止；覆盖智能体采样、训练评估、数据处理等推理工作负载，可在决定干预后 35 秒内停止或暂停任务的模型输出。
原帖：https://x.com/OpenAI/status/2119913172039868579

## 二、AI 视频与世界模型

### 4. Runway 推出 Sightline：360 度全景图任意取景
Runway 推出新功能 Sightline，可创建任意地点的 360 度全景图，再从任意角度取景，环境在每个镜头中保持一致；全景图可导出为 3D 环境用于场景制作，在 App Studio 中可用。
原帖：https://x.com/runwayml/status/2119874555581694370

## 三、金融与市场

### 5. Anthropic 启动 IPO 路演，计划 12 月 10 日纽交所上市
Anthropic 宣布当日启动 IPO 路演，计划 12 月 10 日在纽交所上市，股票代码 $ANTC；AI 大模型公司走向公开市场的标志性一步。
原帖：https://x.com/AnthropicAI/status/2120117722230968385

### 6. 英伟达风波升级：集体诉讼与 75 亿美元芯片出货指控
英伟达及黄仁勋面临集体诉讼，被指控通过隐瞒黄仁勋与一名被美国情报部门认定为中国情报人员的女子的关系来欺诈股东；另据 The Information 报道，该关系至少促成了 75 亿美元的英伟达芯片出货，可追溯至 2023 年。均为帖子所述，未独立核实，引用时须谨慎。
原帖：https://x.com/KobeissiLetter/status/2119937712102760784
原帖：https://x.com/KobeissiLetter/status/2120110889693245744

### 7. 10 月 CPI 将不含同比数字，因 2025 年 10 月政府停摆致数据缺失
美国劳工统计局宣布本周的 10 月 CPI 通胀数据将不包含同比数字，原因是 2025 年 10 月政府停摆导致数据缺失，无法进行可靠的年度比较，仅提供月度数据；明日市场关注点。
原帖：https://x.com/KobeissiLetter/status/2119960893228286123

### 8. 七大科技公司表外义务合计 4.49 万亿美元，约为表内近 6 倍
Alphabet、Meta、Anthropic、微软、亚马逊、甲骨文和英伟达披露的表外义务合计达 4.49 万亿美元（Alphabet 1.08 万亿美元、Anthropic 8,650 亿美元、Meta 8,100 亿美元居前），包括尚未开始的未来租赁付款、数据中心承诺和设备采购；其表内义务合计仅 7,580 亿美元，7 家公司总财务义务约 5.25 万亿美元。
原帖：https://x.com/KobeissiLetter/status/2119879354045915540

### 9. 半导体指数 SOX 跌至 200 日均线下方 17%，为 2025 年 4 月以来最大负偏离
半导体指数 SOX 跌至 200 日均线下方 17%，为 2025 年 4 月以来最大负偏离，也是 2022 年熊市以来第二大偏离，半导体股数月内由极度超买转为超卖。
原帖：https://x.com/KobeissiLetter/status/2119977845267087519

### 10. 软银近两年来首次净亏损，AI 支出担忧拖累科技持仓
软银集团报告近两年来首次净亏损，原因是市场对 AI 支出和需求的担忧拖累其主要科技持仓，是 AI 交易降温的标志性财报信号。
原帖：https://x.com/business/status/2120043789897134231

### 11. 美国油价跌破 85 美元
特朗普表示无需对伊朗追加打击后，美国油价自 8 月 31 日以来首次跌破 85 美元/桶，较 10 月 30 日高点已下跌 19%。
原帖：https://x.com/KobeissiLetter/status/2120083569808699696

### 12. 美国股票基金需求空前，2020 年以来累计流入 2.1 万亿美元
美国股票基金需求空前：2020 年以来累计流入 2.1 万亿美元，2024 年以来占 1.5 万亿美元，是同期新兴市场亚洲基金流入的 4.5 倍，资金流向观察的数据点。
原帖：https://x.com/KobeissiLetter/status/2120010057450418347
